interpretive_fragments.literal_fragment: MINAM NA TEBE OD POSLEDNI SCHU??Y
interpretive_fragments.proposed_czech: [MINAM na tebe od poslední schůzky?; MINAM is the visible cross-row ending of a separate stem, no hidden prefix supplied; SCHU??Y requires Z/K, CH provisional.]
interpretive_fragments.proposed_english: [MINAM … of you since the last meeting?; MINAM is a cross-row ending, not a restored full verb; SCHU??Y requires Z/K, provisional CH.]

interpretive_fragments.literal_fragment: NEUSTALE A STYS?A SE MI PO TOBE
interpretive_fragments.proposed_czech: [Neustále a stýská se mi po tobě?; ? requires q → K.]
interpretive_fragments.proposed_english: [Constantly, and I miss you?; ? requires q → K.]

interpretive_fragments.proposed_czech: [Nesmírně. Kdo je onen tvůj pan…?; ? requires q → K; person/relationship left unresolved.]
interpretive_fragments.proposed_english: [Very much. Who is that gentleman of yours…?; ? requires q → K; person/relationship unresolved.]

interpretive_fragments.proposed_czech: [Dlouhou mimořádnou návštěvu…; fragment, not proof of an actual visit.]
interpretive_fragments.proposed_english: [A long exceptional visit…; fragment, not proof that a visit occurred.]

interpretive_fragments.literal_fragment: VISI JEHO NAVSTEVA S ONIM HOVOREM,
interpretive_fragments.proposed_czech: [VISI jeho návštěva s oním hovorem…; VISI is a cross-row ending, no prefix or global order authenticated.]
interpretive_fragments.proposed_english: [VISI … his visit with that conversation…; VISI is a cross-row ending, no prefix/order authenticated.]

interpretive_fragments.proposed_czech: [Který jsi měla před svým odjezdem?; conditional q/g choices.]
interpretive_fragments.proposed_english: [Which you had before your departure?; conditional q/g choices; departure not historically authenticated.]

interpretive_fragments.literal_fragment: DATI A TE DOPROVA?ETI. TA?E JA,
interpretive_fragments.proposed_czech: [DATI a tě doprovázeti. Také já?; DATI is a separate cross-row ending; conditional g/q choices.]
interpretive_fragments.proposed_english: [DATI … and accompany you. I too?; DATI is a cross-row ending; conditional g/q choices.]

interpretive_fragments.proposed_czech: [Aničko moje jediná, cítím se…?; ? requires q → K, punctuation editorial.]
interpretive_fragments.proposed_english: [My one and only Anička, I feel…?; ? requires q → K, punctuation editorial.]

interpretive_fragments.proposed_czech: [U tebe vždy tak šťasten?; ? require g → Z and q → K.]
interpretive_fragments.proposed_english: [Always so happy with you?; conditional g/q choices.]

interpretive_fragments.literal_fragment: VYCH PUS TI POSILA JEN TVUJ A VECNE
interpretive_fragments.proposed_czech: [VYCH pus ti posílá jen tvůj a věčně…; VYCH is a separate ending; CH provisional.]
interpretive_fragments.proposed_english: [VYCH … kisses are sent to you only by yours and forever…; VYCH is a detached ending; provisional CH.]

interpretive_fragments.literal_fragment: TVUJ PEPOUS. PROSIM, POSLI MI BR?O LI-
interpretive_fragments.proposed_czech: [Tvůj Pepouš. Prosím, pošli mi brzo LI-…?; ? requires g → Z; LI- not silently joined to another row; nickname unidentified.]
interpretive_fragments.proposed_english: [Your Pepouš. Please send me soon LI-…?; ? requires g → Z; no silent cross-row join; nickname unidentified.]
